name: Ranger · Knight style C (Hooded)
description: Style B with a ranger’s hood: Lyra wears a deep-green hood up over her head, joined to her cape by a shoulder mantle pinned with a gold clasp at the throat. The hood is the head’s shape now: its long pointed tail rises off the crown and falls down her back, swaying in her breathing idle, streaming back on the walk and flung back by the shot, as the plumed Knight’s plume does. Under the lit brim a fringe of silver hair and a lock by the cheek show, with her face in 3/4 (teal eye, nose, skin). The cloak (hood, mantle, cape) is a deeper, cooler green than the tunic so the two read apart. As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark shade of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted. She lifts the bow, nocks, draws to the chin (her hand on the nock, the elbow out behind the hood), holds (the arrowhead glints), looses with the string snapping forward and a white crescent and streak flying out, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.
